# ReelEel

> Local-first, FOSS youth-sports video intelligence. Import a whole game, point at
> your athlete once, and get back the passages they were in as a highlight reel.
> Video stays on your machine.

## Install the CLI

```sh
curl -fsSL https://reeleel.com/install.sh | sh
```

Or `npm install -g @profullstack/reeleel` (Node.js 22.5+), or `bun add -g @profullstack/reeleel`.
The command is `reeleel`. It needs FFmpeg and ffprobe on PATH; run `reeleel doctor` to check.
Every command accepts `--json` for machine-readable output.
